results.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest percentage of late deliveries, among states with at least 500 delivered orders?
results.sql:
WITH late_deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_state,
    COUNT(*) AS late_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS s
    ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_state
), total_deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS s
    ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_state
), state_late_pct AS (
  SELECT
    l.customer_state,
    100.0 * l.late_count / t.total_count AS late_pct
  FROM late_deliveries AS l
  JOIN total_deliveries AS t
    ON l.customer_state = t.customer_state
  WHERE
    t.total_count >= 500
)
SELECT
  customer_state,
  late_pct
FROM state_late_pct
ORDER BY
  late_pct DESC
LIMIT 5

5. PA (12.37%)

results.question: Do orders with more than one item get different review scores than single-item orders?
results.sql:
WITH order_item_counts AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS item_count
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY
    order_id
), review_scores AS (
  SELECT
    oic.order_id,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM order_item_counts AS oic
  JOIN order_reviews AS r
    ON oic.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY
    oic.order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN item_count > 1 THEN 'multi-item' ELSE 'single-item' END AS order_type,
  AVG(avg_review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    oic.item_count,
    rs.avg_review_score
  FROM order_item_counts AS oic
  JOIN review_scores AS rs
    ON oic.order_id = rs.order_id
) AS combined_data
GROUP BY
  order_type
LIMIT 1000
results.answer: Orders with more than one item have an average review score of R$ 3.60, while single-item orders have an average review score of R$ 4.16.
